textBlocks.text: DV Oracle is the artificial intelligence for people who sell online: it finds the ads that are already performing and analyzes any competing store, all in one place.

DV Oracle works on two fronts: the , which shows what is already performing before you invest, and the , which analyzes any competing store straight from your browser. Both run on the same account, with the same credits — you choose where t
Data working for you, around the clock.
An AI shows what already works before you invest
Our AI scans thousands of live ads and separates the ones that are truly performing, so you do not have to dig through them one by one.
Access any competitor in one click
The DV Oracle extension AI estimates traffic, catalog and revenue for any store, right on the page you are viewing.
Everything in one place, on the same account
The ad library and the extension share one login and one credit balance, with no separate tools to open.
Two tools that work together so you sell more.
Thousands of live ads, filtered by an AI that separates what is actually performing right now. Filter by niche, product or creative format.
Install in one click and analyze any competing store straight from your browser. An AI estimates traffic, revenue and catalog in seconds.
What you can expect from DV Oracle.
A continuously updated ad catalog, with product and creative side by side.
One-click extension install, with real catalog data (Shopify stores).
AI-generated estimates for traffic, revenue and ads.
Catalog and pricing are real, public data taken straight from the store.
The AI reprocesses ads and stores continuously. What you see is always the current picture, not a snapshot from months ago.
Through your dashboard or by installing the Chrome extension.
Filter by niche or product, or analyze any competing store you like in one click.
Use the data (ads, traffic, catalog, estimated revenue) as your reference for what to sell and how to advertise.
Ad library and extension, with no separate tools to open.
Every analysis is done by artificial intelligence, updated continuously.
Dropshipping, marketplaces or ecommerce in general.
You do not need to be a DV Shipping client to use it.
Intelligence for people who sell online

No. DV Shipping clients get free access to the Ad Library. Everyone else can subscribe separately. The Chrome extension is free for anyone, with credits included.
